headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 13, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 16.53% compared to SPY's 10.56%. This results in an average alpha of 5.97%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a substantial return of 44.04%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned 9.07%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This outperformance is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, reinforcing the portfolio's strength relative to broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
